profile.name: Risha Anugerah Nenu Lema, S.T.
profile.title: Electrical Engineer & Industrial Automation Specialist
profile.location: Gifu City, Japan (Home base: Semarang, Indonesia)
profile.summary: Bachelor of Electrical Engineering specializing in control systems, industrial automation, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Proven track record of leading engineering departments of 60+ personnel, deploying LEAN Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), autonomous maintenance, and programming multi-axis servo robotics, PLC, and HMI systems.

projects.title: Machine Utilization & Telemetry IoT System
projects.summary: A real-time machine utilization monitoring system to precisely record running time, downtime, and idle time. Data is calculated using a Real-Time Clock (RTC) on a microcontroller from limit switch sensors and pedal potentiometers, then transmitted wirelessly via an ESP8266 IoT module directly to a Google Spreadsheet cloud server and an HMI screen.
projects.goals: Determining effective daily machine operating hours so that the Engineering Department can accurately calculate preventive maintenance schedules and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
projects.madeWith: Automation Department PT MAS Arya Indonesia

projects.title: Quadcopter Flight Controller Berbasis IMU & ATMEGA 2560
projects.summary: Development of an independent flight controller system for a quadcopter based on the ATMEGA 2560 microcontroller. Implementing a PID control algorithm to produce stable PWM pulses to each brushless motor ESC based on sensor data readings from the IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit: accelerometer & gyroscope) and remote control receiver signals.
projects.goals: Generating a precise quadcopter flight control system, stable against wind disturbances, and equipped with 3 communication access pins for Base Station system integration and GPS module navigation.
projects.metrics: PID hovering stability with sub-millisecond correction response.

projects.title: Industrial 3-Axis CNC Gantry Robot & Plotter
projects.summary: Rancang bangun robot gantry 3-sumbu (X-Y-Z) presisi tinggi untuk kebutuhan pameran otomasi industri Indonesia 2017. Menggunakan mikrokontroler Arduino Mega 2560 untuk membaca dan menerjemahkan data G-Code dari PC, kemudian mengirimkan pulsa kendali ke AC Servo Driver untuk menggerakkan AC Servo Motor 50 Watt pada setiap sumbu mekanis.
projects.goals: Mendemonstrasikan kecepatan, presisi mikron, dan kapabilitas integrasi motor AC Servo modern pada aplikasi gerak industri seperti CNC milling, dispensing, dan robot plotter.
projects.madeWith: Technical Engineering Team PT Unindo Hitech Pratama
projects.metrics: Presisi gerak multi-sumbu simultan untuk demo industri

projects.title: HMI Machine Controller - Mesin Press Bending Backgauge
projects.client: PT Nobel Techtrotonic Surabaya / PT Unindo Hitech Pratama
projects.summary: Pengembangan perangkat lunak HMI khusus berbasis C# Visual Studio untuk mengontrol jarak pre-fold backgauge pada mesin tekuk plat (press brake refurbishment). Aplikasi dapat menyimpan berbagai resep setting pelat dan mengirim perintah gerak posisi langsung ke AC Servo Driver menggunakan PDL (Process Description Language) serta SDK driver.
projects.goals: Modernisasi sistem kendali mesin bending hidrolik lama agar operator dapat memasukkan ukuran tekukan secara digital via layar sentuh dengan presisi tinggi dan pemantauan sensor limit switch real-time.
projects.metrics: Akurasi positioning backgauge hingga toleransi <0.1 mm
